title: Prevent duplicate TV output folder nesting
summary: Prevents TV output planning from appending a TV library folder when the selected library profile output root already points at a TV leaf folder.
reason: A TV Library Profile can use an output root such as \\LAYNE-SERVER\Users\Layne\Videos\outsource\TV. With CreateTVSubfolder enabled, output planning also requested a TV relative folder, producing \\LAYNE-SERVER\Users\Layne\Videos\outsource\TV\TV\Show\Season output paths.
behavior_before: When CreateTVSubfolder was enabled, TV output planning always prefixed relative paths with TV, even when the selected library output root already ended in TV.
behavior_after: TV output planning keeps the configured CreateTVSubfolder behavior for shared output roots, but suppresses the extra TV prefix when the selected library output root leaf is already TV.
tests_added: Added Library Profile routing coverage proving shared TV output roots still include TV/Show/Season while TV-leaf output roots produce Show/Season instead of TV/TV/Show/Season.
